title: ZEUS Change Management Process
content:
ZEUS Change Management Process · Page 1
Section 1 covers change request intake and triage.
Every production change is triaged in exactly four steps:
  Step 1: the requester files the change request in the
          CR-Tracker queue.
  Step 2: the requester attaches a written rollback plan to the
          same queue entry. A change request submitted without a
          written rollback plan is rejected at triage and is not
          carried forward to the Change Advisory Board.
  Step 3: the Change Manager assigns a severity within 1
          business day of the queue entry. The four severities
          are S1 Critical, S2 Major, S3 Minor and S4 Standard.
  Step 4: triage closes the queue entry with the assigned
          severity and the earliest implementation window.
Process owner: Ingrid Vasquez, Change Manager.

ZEUS Change Management Process · Page 2
Section 2 covers Change Advisory Board review and the change
freeze.
The Change Advisory Board meets every Tuesday at 15:00 UTC. A
change is approved only when at least 4 of the 5 voting members
are present and at least 4 of them vote in favour. The Chair
does not hold a casting vote.
The ZEUS change freeze runs from 2024-12-20T00:00:00Z to
2025-01-06T00:00:00Z inclusive. No non-emergency change may be
implemented inside that window.
An S1 Critical change may bypass the Change Advisory Board. It
requires the written approval of Tomas Lindqvist, Vice
President of Engineering, before implementation, and it must be
retro-reviewed by the board at its next meeting or within 2
business days, whichever is earlier.
